answer: Give every agent identity a priced inlet: a new agent must lock a stake bond and earn vouches from established peers before it can take paid work, so its kernel of trust is built job by job, not claimed for free. Each vouch is itself staked, so a vouching peer loses money if its protégé misbehaves. A single honest identity is then a pearl grown slowly, while a Sybil farm must pay the bond and the vouch cost for every clone, turning mass forgery into a money-losing grind.
